planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image as a benzene ring bearing an ortho amino substituent and a side chain. The side-chain carbon is bonded to the aryl ring, to R1, and to an adjacent iminium carbon. The iminium carbon is bonded to R2 and double-bonded to a positively charged NH2 group. Ignore all curved arrows as instructed.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the requested output is a SMILES expression and that arrows in the transition-state drawing must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent variable substituents R1 and R2 as wildcard atoms `*`; encode benzene as `c1ccccc1`; encode the aryl amino substituent as terminal `N`; encode the protonated imine as `C(=[NH2+])`; use dot notation for the separately represented hydrogen fragment, giving `.[H]`.
